verdict.rationale: Supabase's own docs say its APIs are generated from the database and that introspection produces type-safe definitions. A `database.types.ts` file can be generated through the type-generation guide, downloaded from the dashboard, or produced by the MCP `generate_typescript_types` tool. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, documented automatic regeneration when the schema changes (e.g. a CI hook), evidence of languages beyond TypeScript.

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate typed client code (e.g. TypeScript types) from my schema automatically

citations.quote: Supabase APIs are generated from your database, which means that we can use database introspection to generate type-safe API definitions.
Generate types for your project to produce the `database.types.ts` file
Supabase allows you to generate and download TypeScript types directly from the project dashboard.
